title: Restore alert detection and notification, and monitor the alerting system itself

sha_binding.verified_source_note: Exact committed lane source after refreshing the branch to origin/main (behind=0). Carries the five PM-required corrections and the fixes for every defect found by two independent adversarial reviews. Post-merge closeout rebinds the proof to the authoritative merge SHA.
sha_binding.head_binding_note: current_pr_head_sha is the CI sentinel, not a literal SHA, per this bundle's ci_sentinels block. Two earlier revisions hardcoded it and it was stale in both, because the commit that records a head SHA necessarily changes the head. verified_source_sha is the stable anchor: it names the commit carrying the complete lane source, and later commits in this lane are restricted to proof artifacts.

focused_tests.detail: 20 node:test cases: line-movement detection and persistence, live-mode canary notification, alerting silence, stale ingestion, failed delivery, unknown monitor state, workflow posture, observed-cadence threshold calibration in both directions, the production threshold floor honouring operator values above it, member-target withholding, transport-level member refusal, fail-closed behaviour on an unresolvable target map, non-message requests passing through, undelivered-detection retry built from a real alert_detections row shape, and an end-to-end alert-worthy pass proving canary delivery with the member channel withheld. Also covers the workflow pinning ALERT_SYSTEM_STALE_MINUTES to 60 and the member flag to false. Two further cases assert the pass restores the global target map it mutated, including when startRun throws before delivery.

verify_static.detail: Environment checks, policy checks, lint, type-check, build, aggregate tests, Smart Form verification, and command verification passed.

pnpm_verify.detail: The full static stage passed. The final writable DB stage refused the workstation loopback target before executing DB tests, as required for a T1 lane.

r_level_check.detail: 9 changed files; no R-level rules matched and no R-level artifacts are required for this diff.

static_proof.type_check_scope_caveat: scripts/ is outside every tsconfig project reference, so pnpm type-check and pnpm lint both pass even with the original nonexistent-column defect reintroduced. member_channel_guard.policy: Member-facing alert delivery is unauthorized. The safe default is canary-only; member channels require a separate activation decision via ALERT_MEMBER_CHANNELS_ENABLED=true.
member_channel_guard.fixture: NBA spread moved from 4.5 to 9.0 (above the 3.5 alert-worthy threshold) with BOTH discord:canary and discord:trader-insights resolvable in the target map, so the member channel was genuinely reachable and only the guard prevented delivery.
observed: every outbound Discord request went to canary channel 1296531122234327100; none reached member channel 1296531122234327999
notification.failed = 0 and notification.notified = 1: a withheld member channel is a policy decision, not a delivery failure
detection persisted at tier alert-worthy, marked notified, notified_channels = ['discord:canary']

the alert.notification run records memberTargetsWithheld = ['discord:trader-insights'] and blockedMemberChannels = 0, showing the member target was withheld before delivery so the transport was never reached
guard fails closed: when the target map cannot be resolved, no channel is permitted
member_channel_guard.validated_by_inversion: Two layers, both re-measured at this head against the 20-test suite. Disabling only the transport guard: tests 11 and 12 fail (# tests 20 / # pass 18 / # fail 2) and grep for 'member channel was contacted' returns 0 matches, because the policy layer still strips the target. Disabling BOTH layers: tests 11, 12, 17 and 18 fail (# tests 20 / # pass 16 / # fail 4) with 'member channel was contacted: https://discord.com/api/v10/channels/1296531122234327100/messages, https://discord.com/api/v10/channels/1296531122234327999/messages'. Restoring both returns 20 passed, 0 failed. An earlier revision of this bundle quoted a single '# fail 3' transcript; it came from a transport-only revision, does not reproduce against this design, and is withdrawn.
enforcement_layers: primary: applyMemberChannelPolicy strips every non-canary entry from UNIT_TALK_DISCORD_TARGET_MAP unless ALERT_MEMBER_CHANNELS_ENABLED=true, so the delivery loop skips the member channel with no attempt, no retry ladder, and no audit rows
defence in depth: buildChannelGuardedFetch throws on any Discord message POST to a non-canary channel and fails closed when the target map cannot be resolved
member_channel_guard.known_limitation: Enforced in this script only. packages/alert-runtime/src/alert-agent.ts calls runAlertNotificationPass with no injected fetchImpl, so apps/alert-agent would deliver to discord:trader-insights unguarded. That path is dormant (last alert.detection run 2026-04-28). Making the policy a system property requires changing resolveChannels, which is outside this lane's scope.
member_channel_guard.cost_defect_corrected: An earlier revision enforced this only at the transport. A refused channel then burned the full retry ladder — four attempts and seven seconds of real sleep per detection — so roughly 86 alert-worthy detections would exhaust timeout-minutes: 10. The counter also counted attempts rather than distinct channels, reading 4x high.
member_channel_guard.activation_path_verified: With ALERT_MEMBER_CHANNELS_ENABLED=true the map is left untouched and a full pass delivers to both canary and discord:trader-insights, so the activation decision genuinely reaches member channels rather than being inert.
member_channel_guard.exact_behaviour: applyMemberChannelPolicy is a canary-only allowlist, not a member-only strip: every non-canary target is removed, including non-member ones such as discord:best-bets. That is correct for this pass, which only ever delivers to canary, and it fails closed for any target added to the map later.
member_channel_guard.global_env_mutation: The policy rewrites process.env.UNIT_TALK_DISCORD_TARGET_MAP, which apps/api and apps/worker read directly. Both mutations -- the global one and the caller-injected one -- and everything from the startRun await down are inside a try/finally, so the map is restored on every exit path: success, a delivery failure, a throw on the system_runs insert, a throw inside the error handler's completeRun, and a throwing write to a frozen or proxied injected environment. Two tests cover the normal pass and a stubbed startRun failure; removing the finally fails both, and regressing to the pre-fix shape fails the startRun one.

undelivered_retry.defect: A detection persisted while Discord was unavailable collided with its idempotency key on later passes and was counted as a duplicate rather than returned in persistedSignals, so it was never retried after Discord recovered.
observed: mergeUndeliveredDetections re-submits recent detections whose notified flag is false
a detection already present in the current pass is not duplicated
a detection already delivered (notified true) is not resent
a detection outside the four-hour retry window is not resent
a retry-lookup failure cannot suppress the current pass's own alerts
undelivered_retry.corrected_defect: An earlier revision filtered on a `detected_at` field. `alert_detections` has no such column (verified against packages/db/src/database.types.ts: the row exposes created_at, current_snapshot_at, baseline_snapshot_at). Every candidate therefore failed Date.parse and the retry silently returned zero. It now reads `created_at` with no cast, and the test fixture is built from a real AlertDetectionRecord instead of a hand-written shape.
undelivered_retry.runtime_measurement: A probe persisted one genuinely undelivered alert-worthy detection via saveDetection and called the shipped function: rows=1, has created_at=true, notified=false, RETRIED COUNT = 1. The same probe measured 0 before this correction.
undelivered_retry.lookup_window: listRecent orders by current_snapshot_at with no notified filter, so its limit truncates BEFORE the age cutoff is applied. The limit is 2000; production currently holds 176 undelivered rows, so the earlier limit of 200 was uncomfortably close to silently dropping retries behind newer rows.
undelivered_retry.backlog_safety: All 176 undelivered production rows were created between 2026-04-26 17:55 and 2026-04-28 14:44 UTC (77 of them on 04-28), roughly 117 days old, so the four-hour cutoff prevents the first live run from delivering the backlog. Measured directly against zfzdnfwdarxucxtaojxm.

threshold_calibration.rationale: The workflow is scheduled */5 but eight consecutive production runs were measured 18-49 minutes apart (gaps 20/29/36/49/18/24/21, effective cadence near 28). The previous nominal-5 clamp would mark a healthy system CRITICAL on nearly every pass once ingestion resumes.
threshold_calibration.change: offers and cycle clamp to a 60-minute observed-cadence FLOOR under --production-cadence, honouring larger operator values above it. The workflow's ALERT_SYSTEM_STALE_MINUTES default was also corrected from 15 to 60, because the alert.detection/alert.notification runs that threshold watches are produced by the same throttled scheduler.
observed: a six-minute-old offer is not CRITICAL
a ninety-minute-old offer is CRITICAL at threshold 60m
a value below the floor is raised to 60; a value above it (120) is honoured, so the env knob is not disabled
threshold_calibration.supersedes: Item 3 of UTV2-1738, which recorded this as an untuned follow-up.
threshold_calibration.corrected_defect: An earlier revision computed Math.max(Math.min(x, 5), 60), which is always exactly 60 and silently disabled both UNIT_TALK_INGESTOR_OFFER_STALE_MINUTES and INGESTOR_ALERT_CYCLE_THRESHOLD_MINUTES. The workflow also still pinned ALERT_SYSTEM_STALE_MINUTES to 15, making the previous 60-minute self-monitor claim false at that head.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Alert detection and notification run on a production cadence.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: The workflow runs a live-mode scheduled alerting pass before the monitor job. The */5 schedule is not honoured under load; measured effective cadence is roughly 28 minutes, and thresholds are calibrated to that observed cadence rather than the nominal one.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Alerting system silence and delivery failures are observable.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: The monitor checks persisted alert.detection and alert.notification runs and treats missing/stale/failed receipts as CRITICAL. Scope stated precisely: the monitor is needs: alerting-pass inside the same workflow run, so always() grants independence from that job's OUTCOME, not from the SCHEDULE. It is structurally blind to the scheduler never dispatching at all (precedent: UTV2-1517). External scheduler-death detection is out of scope here and owned by UTV2-1738.
Merged offer freshness reads provider_cycle_status.updated_at; result freshness reads game_results.created_at; no provider_offers.updated_at query remains in the workflow script.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: The repaired alert path is executable without enabling autonomous system picks.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: ALERT_DRY_RUN is false for delivery, SYSTEM_PICKS_ENABLED remains false, and the focused test observes persisted detection and notification behavior.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Writable T1 verification runs only against governed staging credentials.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: The local staging identity guard refused host 127.0.0.1 before any writable DB test ran.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Member-facing alert delivery remains unauthorized; the safe default is canary-only.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Enforced in two layers: applyMemberChannelPolicy withholds every non-canary target from the resolvable map, and buildChannelGuardedFetch refuses any non-canary Discord channel at the transport. The workflow sets that variable explicitly to 'false'; activating member delivery requires setting it to 'true', which this lane does not do. Both layers proven by inversion; see runtime_proof.member_channel_guard.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Persisted-but-undelivered alerts are retried without duplicating successful deliveries.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: mergeUndeliveredDetections re-submits recent detections with notified=false, excluding those already in the pass, already delivered, or outside the retry window. See runtime_proof.undelivered_retry.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Thresholds are calibrated against the observed scheduler cadence to prevent routine false CRITICALs.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Production thresholds clamp to a 60-minute observed-cadence floor. See runtime_proof.threshold_calibration.

sign_off.independent_review_defects_fixed: An independent adversarial review at the preceding head 3b9dfd4b (since rewritten) returned CHANGES_REQUIRED with five blockers. All five are fixed at this head: the dead retry column, its self-confirming test fixture, the workflow pinning the self-monitor threshold to 15, the un-recomputed evidence counts, and a stale contradictory Safety posture section. Two follow-ups (the constant threshold expression and the retry-ladder cost) are also fixed; the alert-agent entry point and lane classification are disclosed as known limitations.
sign_off.second_review_defects_fixed: A second independent adversarial review confirmed the implementation fixes all seven prior items and returned CHANGES_REQUIRED on the proof bundle only: a stale diff stat asserted as recomputed, a non-reproducible inversion transcript, and a blockedMemberDeliveries claim contradicted by the code. All three are corrected here from measured output. Its code follow-ups are also fixed: the unrestored global env mutation, the retry lookup window truncating before the age cutoff, the untested workflow default, and a fixture field that violated a NOT NULL column type.
sign_off.third_review_defects_fixed: A third independent adversarial review confirmed all three prior proof blockers genuinely fixed and found four residual text defects plus one code leak. Fixed here: a re-assertion of the withdrawn type-system claim that survived elsewhere in the file, a stale '17 node:test cases' string beside a tests:19 field, a measured DB date stated as a single day when the range is 04-26 to 04-28, and the restore being reachable only after startRun rather than in a finally.
sign_off.fourth_review_defects_fixed: A fourth independent adversarial review confirmed R1, R3 and R4 genuinely fixed by execution and returned CHANGES_REQUIRED on one field: runtime_proof.member_channel_guard.validated_by_inversion still carried the 19-test suite's counts while verification.md and evidence.json's own tests:20 disagreed. That field is rewritten from measured output. Its two follow-ups are also taken: the injected-environment mutation moved inside the try so the restore no longer depends on that branch being unreachable, and a duplicated sentence that implied three restore tests rather than two removed.
